allow_partial_tuning.title: Allow Partial Tuning
allow_partial_tuning.description: Accepts a budget or a database that does not cover every task; for quick tests only.

benchmark_runs.title: Benchmark Runs
benchmark_runs.description: Timed inferences of the finished library, saved in metadata.json; 0 turns the benchmark off.

cross_cc.title: Cross Compiler
cross_cc.description: C++ compiler that links model.so for another architecture; empty chooses it from the target.

exec_mode.title: Execution Mode
exec_mode.description: bytecode: the Relax VM interprets the model graph; compiled: the graph becomes native code.

image.title: Container Image
image.description: Image of the compile Job; empty uses the TVM toolkit image configured on the platform.

max_trials_per_task.title: Max Trials Per Task
max_trials_per_task.description: Most candidates measured for a single task.

model_path.title: IR Model
model_path.description: The tvm-ir Model to compile; empty uses the one written by tvm+build in the function.

opt_level.title: Optimization Level
opt_level.description: TVM optimization level, from 0 to 3: higher values turn on more optimizations.

params_path.title: Parameters File
params_path.description: Path, inside the Job, of a params.bin to embed; empty uses the one of the IR.

rpc_session_timeout_sec.title: RPC Session Timeout (s)
rpc_session_timeout_sec.description: Maximum seconds of one remote measurement session.

rpc_tracker_host.title: RPC Tracker Host
rpc_tracker_host.description: Address of the TVM RPC tracker; required with the rpc runner.

rpc_tracker_key.title: RPC Tracker Key
rpc_tracker_key.description: Key the target devices are registered with; required with the rpc runner.

rpc_tracker_port.title: RPC Tracker Port
rpc_tracker_port.description: Port of the TVM RPC tracker; required with the rpc runner.

system_lib.title: System Library
system_lib.description: Builds a library whose functions register themselves, for systems without dynamic loading; the serve images cannot load it.

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: Suffix of the compiled Model name, <function>-<tag>; use one tag per target.

target_architecture.title: Target
target_architecture.description: Hardware the library is built for: cpu (generic, node of the Job), x86 (x86-64-v2), x86_v3 (AVX2), x86_native (CPU of the Job), arm64, arm64_pi5 (Raspberry Pi 5), armv7l (32-bit ARM).

target_num_cores.title: Target Number of Cores
target_num_cores.description: Physical cores of the target: the tuned schedules and the tuning threads use this value; empty uses the CPU request of the Job.

tir_pipeline.title: TIR Pipeline
tir_pipeline.description: Predefined low-level passes run before code generation.

tuning_alloc_repeat.title: Allocation Repeats
tuning_alloc_repeat.description: Sets of random inputs each candidate is timed on.

tuning_builder_timeout_sec.title: Builder Timeout (s)
tuning_builder_timeout_sec.description: Maximum seconds to compile one candidate.

tuning_enable_cpu_cache_flush.title: Flush CPU Cache
tuning_enable_cpu_cache_flush.description: Flushes the CPU caches before each measurement, for steadier results.

tuning_min_repeat_ms.title: Min Repeat Time (ms)
tuning_min_repeat_ms.description: Fast kernels run again until one measurement lasts at least this long.

tuning_mode.title: Tuning Mode
tuning_mode.description: off skips tuning, tune searches the best schedules with MetaSchedule, apply reuses a database tuned earlier.

tuning_model_path.title: Tuning Database Source
tuning_model_path.description: Compiled Model whose tuning database tune resumes or apply reuses; required with apply.

tuning_ops.title: Operator Names
tuning_ops.description: Tunes only the tasks whose name contains one of these words, e.g. conv2d; empty tunes all.

tuning_repeat.title: Measurement Repeats
tuning_repeat.description: Independent measurements taken for each candidate.

tuning_runner.title: Runner
tuning_runner.description: Where candidates are timed: local on the compile Job, rpc on a device registered with a TVM RPC tracker.

tuning_runner_timeout_sec.title: Runner Timeout (s)
tuning_runner_timeout_sec.description: Maximum seconds to time one candidate with the local runner; rpc uses the session timeout.

tuning_seed.title: Random Seed
tuning_seed.description: Seed of the search, for reproducible results.

tuning_trials.title: Max Trials (Global)
tuning_trials.description: Total candidates measured across all tasks; required with tune.

tuning_trials_per_iter.title: Trials Per Iteration
tuning_trials_per_iter.description: Candidates built and measured for each task in one round.

tuning_workers.title: Max Workers
tuning_workers.description: Candidates compiled in parallel; with rpc also the parallel device connections.
